'''Roshan''' is a [[Warder]] to [[Samitsu Tamagowa]].

==History== 
He certainly did not want to become a Warder, not until Samitsu said she wanted him for one.

==Activities==
Samitsu misses him when she visited the rebels' camp near Cairhien and she wishes he were present to make her feel safer during the [[bubble of evil]] that is hitting the camp. A far as we know, he has still not been reunited with his [[Aes Sedai]].
